levels.label: 1. OG · module layout
levels.source: Resident House 51 / 1. OG drawing, 15 November 2026: split G-H, N3-N4 and W1; add N0 and two A-bank singles; retain shared A; align the enlarged A bank LEFT edge with L1 LEFT edge; add two balcony enclosures; ignore the blue-covered W-row.
levels.notes: House 51 / 1. OG is the second physical storey shown in the resident annotation. Only this floor changes; EG, the accepted 2. OG and all other houses are preserved. The plan has twenty-three single apartments and one shared A envelope. G-H, N3-N4 and W1 are divided into singles; N0 and two A-bank singles are added. The blue-covered extra W-row is ignored. The enlarged A bank moves right by one 3.10 m pitch from its unaligned sketch position. Its leftmost F module and L1 both start at local U=25.60 m; both clear interiors start at U=25.80 m. The stair and R/L core do not move. Single interiors remain 2.70 x 6.00 m, with two 0.20 m side allocations and 3.10 m pitch. Halls remain 1.40 m wide; shared A uses the accepted 6.20 x 7.40 m gross envelope with unresolved internals. The two balcony enclosures fill the remaining 6.20 m core-side gaps. Their 2.90 m depth is inherited from the accepted balcony assumption, not measured from this drawing. Visible lime marks identify doorway ends. Openings are schematic: 0.90 m wide, centred 0.60 m from the indicated edge with a 0.15 m jamb. W1 has no distinct uncovered lime mark; its bottom-end doorway continues the adjacent alternating pattern. The West balcony doorway is schematic near the stairs. The outline is the complete union of modules, halls, stair and balconies, without residual gray floor. The accepted Yellow coordinate frame retains the absorbed 0.40 m core offset; geometry is not scaled to the folded exterior. Room facade window symbols, doorway offsets, stair treads and internal fittings remain schematic. Folded exterior geometry and its source window evidence remain separate and unchanged.

levels.label: 2. OG · module layout
levels.source: Resident Yellow House 51 top-floor annotation, 15 November 2026: add A-wing E and N0, retain the three-room W wing, remove the blue-marked residual extensions and place doors at the marked ends.
levels.notes: Yellow House 51 top-floor arrangement follows the resident annotation of 15 November 2026; EG and 1. OG remain exactly as previously drawn and await separate instructions. The twenty-one single apartments are the nineteen existing top-floor modules plus E at the left of the A wing and N0 at the right of the N wing. The W wing retains W4, W3 and W2 only. The independent floor outline is the union of whole 3.10 m modules, 1.40 m hallways and the accepted 2.70 x 7.40 m stair block. The blue-marked extensions and other residual source-shell gaps are removed from this floor only. Clear single interiors remain 2.70 x 6.00 m with two 0.20 m side allocations. The room width is resident measured; room length, wall allocations, hall width and stair split remain the accepted modeling assumptions. The lime marks determine which end of each room-to-hall wall receives its door. Doorways are drawn 0.90 m wide with their centre 0.60 m from the indicated clear-room edge, leaving a schematic 0.15 m jamb. These offsets are not new measurements. Both E labels are retained as drawn: the added E in the A wing and the existing E in the East wing have separate identifiers and descriptive selection labels. The existing rigid Yellow registration and its retained 0.40 m core offset keep the stair block aligned with the untouched lower floors. Room dimensions are neither fitted nor scaled to the folded exterior. Layout window symbols, door offsets, stair treads and room internals remain schematic. The folded Yellow exterior and all original facade window evidence are preserved separately.
